### CVE-2016-0006
- Assigner: microsoft | Published: 2016-01-13 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 39311: Microsoft Windows - Sandboxed Mount Reparse Point Creation Mitigation Bypass Redux (MS16-008) (1) (local/windows, 2016-01-25, verified=1)
